Equivalent to graduation from high school.
Two (2) years of experience in the handling and maintenance of athletic equipment and supplies.
Oversee the daily operation of laundry, including washing, drying, folding, and coordinating the distribution of practice and game uniforms, towels, equipment, and supplies for the athletic teams.
Assist with issuing receiving, storing, and checking athletic equipment for a variety of sports.

Match purchase orders to invoices, inspect items for quality and condition, monitor changes in purchase orders; communicate with vendors to help resolve problems with equipment received. Assist in monitoring budgets and preparing purchase requisitions for the purchase of athletic equipment, uniforms, and supplies. Assist with recordkeeping related to purchases, equipment and facility operations.
Clean, organize, and maintain athletic equipment, uniforms, and supplies.

Determine the need for replacement of various equipment; research vendors to determine replacement availability; recommend the purchase of athletic and safety equipment; assist in coordinating the ordering and purchasing of equipment; maintain proper inventory and records.
Helmet and shoulder pad fitting and basic repair.
Operate a computer to manage inventory, maintain locker and lock assignments, and produce reports.
Oversee security and operation of locker room areas; issue and maintain lockers and locks; make requests for maintenance of facilities as needed.
Set up and break down equipment for athletic events, classes and community facility rentals in accordance with sport competition specifications.
Provide assistance and support with scoring systems during athletic events, classes and facility rentals as necessary.
Assist students, staff, and faculty by responding to inquiries and resolving problems related to athletics.

Maintain positive relationships with campus administrative leadership, faculty, students, community members, and game officials with respect, integrity, and support for the diverse community we serve.
Train and provide work directions to student workers.
Assist with logistics for athletes and equipment to away games as required; assist with packing, loading equipment for travel games and events.
Operate a variety of equipment including vans, cars, utility task vehicles like carts, vacuum cleaner, washing machine, dryer, dolly, computer, calculators and game day technology.
Performs other related duties as required.
Equipment and supplies used in team and individual sports programs.
Receive, issue, collect, store, and inventory athletic equipment and uniforms.
Methods of maintenance, storage, and repair of athletic equipment.
Perform minor equipment repairs and assess the need for replacements.
Procedures for inventory control and procurement.
Set up and maintain athletic equipment and facilities.
Athletic programs at community colleges and the basic rules of athletic events.
Follow oral and written directions.
Helmet and shoulder pad fitting and basic repair.
Work independently.
Office procedures and use of standard software and computer systems.
Organize and prioritize tasks to meet deadlines.
Principles of safety, supervision, and training.
Maintain accurate and organized records and reports.
Safe work practices.
Provide supervision and direction to student workers.
Establish and maintain effective working relationships.
Demonstrate sensitivity to and understanding of diverse student populations.
Understanding of, sensitivity to, and respect for the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, and ethnic backgrounds of Peralta Colleges’ students, faculty, staff, and community.
Communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.
Operate standard office and athletic equipment.
